factsToCheck: Node titles follow the UPSC CSE Mains Public Administration syllabus wording; check every title against the current UPSC CSE notification before publishing
Paper 1 is Administrative Theory (12 units) and Paper 2 is Indian Administration (14 units), as in the UPSC notification
Some long UPSC units were split across nodes at semicolons; check that no syllabus phrase was dropped or reworded in the split
Paper 1 unit 2 lists Weber's bureaucratic model with 'its critique and post-Weberian Developments'; check exact punctuation
Paper 1 unit 8 writes 'Antidevelopment thesis' as one word in quotation marks; check against the notification
Paper 2 unit 5 refers to the Planning Commission and the National Development Council; the syllabus wording predates NITI Aayog (2015) and is kept as UPSC prints it
Paper 2 unit 5 'Constitutional Amendments (1992)' refers to the 73rd and 74th Amendments
Node count: Paper 1 has 52 nodes, Paper 2 has 39 nodes; each is planned as 1 to 3 study hours
